name: znetwork_dplay_create_local_player_record
description: zNetwork_DPlay::CreateLocalPlayerRecordAndRegister creates the local DirectPlay player record, caches local identity, refreshes caps/messages, and appends the record to the player list.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
DirectPlay CreatePlayer and GetPlayerCaps are verified through the native fake IDirectPlay4 vtable rather than a live DirectPlay provider.
User-facing DirectPlay creation error dialogs are implemented from Binary Ninja evidence but are not exercised by the smoke to avoid modal UI during verification.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a9c0 validates allocating a 0xe4-byte zNetworkPlayerRecord, initializing the DPNAME fields from the caller player name, calling zNetwork_DPlay::EnumPlayers, and invoking DirectPlay CreatePlayer at vtable slot 0x18 with player id, name info, null data, zero data size, and zero flags.

BN validates zeroing and sizing the player caps structure, calling DirectPlay GetPlayerCaps at slot 0x4c, storing caps flag bit 1 in g_zNetwork_IsHostFlag, pumping pending messages, reporting GetPlayerCaps failures at znet_dplay.cpp line 0x20e, and updating local player key/count/list/color state on success.

The native smoke verifies CreatePlayer arguments, local-name scratch/name copies, GetPlayerCaps arguments and host flag, cached local player key, current-player count, intrusive-list insertion after EnumPlayers, host color allocation, and the GetPlayerCaps failure return path.
